ValidationRule.description: An Agent must take the ownership of the case for it to it able to update them. If it is assigned to a bottler then the agent is not required to update the ownership.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $UserRole.DeveloperName = 'CCNA_Frontline_Agent', ISPICKVAL( Country_Code__c , 'US'), NOT(Owner:User.Id = $User.Id), NOT( OR( CONTAINS(RIGHT(Owner:Queue.DeveloperName, 2), 'BC'), ISCHANGED(OwnerId) ) ), NOT(ISNEW()) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Agents must take the ownership of the case to work on them or else transfer it to other eligible Bottler/Specialist Queues.
